title: Care Management Bulletin: Weekly Rate on Prior Authorization Extension Requests
content:
For a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension request, the weekly rate — the number of units a week that is multiplied by the weeks of the request — follows the member's recent attendance on the authorization and the member's Care Management care plan.

## Rule

- Where at least one but fewer than twice the class's weekly frequency cap of uses were posted on the authorization with service dates in the two months before the day of the request, and a care plan update was recorded in the month before that day, the rate is **2 units a week**.
- Where no use was posted on the authorization in those two months, or fewer than twice the weekly frequency cap were posted and no such care plan update was recorded, the rate is **1 unit a week**.
- Otherwise — that is, where twice the weekly frequency cap or more of uses were posted in those two months — the rate is the class's weekly frequency cap.

The uses counted are the units posted as used on this authorization whose service dates fall in the two months before the day of the request. The care plan update is one recorded by the member's Care Management care team in the month before the day of the request.

## Combinations

| Units posted as used in the two months | Care plan update in the month | Weekly rate |
|---|---|---|
| none | recorded | 1 unit |
| none | not recorded | 1 unit |
| at least one, fewer than twice the cap | recorded | 2 units |
| at least one, fewer than twice the cap | not recorded | 1 unit |
| twice the cap or more | recorded | the weekly frequency cap |
| twice the cap or more | not recorded | the weekly frequency cap |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical class with a weekly frequency cap of 3 units)

Twice the cap is 6 units.

- 5 units posted in the two months and a care plan update recorded in the month: 5 is at least one and fewer than 6, so the rate is 2 units a week.
- 6 units posted, with or without a care plan update: 6 is not fewer than 6, so the rate is 3 units a week.
- 1 unit posted and no care plan update: the rate is 1 unit a week.
- No unit posted, care plan update recorded: the rate is 1 unit a week.
